serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
#bot.Expression.Happy
Bot: {f_playerName}! According to my dietary estimations based on your recent diet you are in dire need of vitamin A. For that reason I prepared for you freshly squeezed carrot juice that is loaded with beta-carotene!
#bot.Expression.clear
#bot.Expression.shock
You: Carrot juice? I’m not a big fan of vegetable juices.
#bot.Expression.clear
#bot.Expression.angry
Bot: {f_playerName}… This is your health we are talking about. Do you want to make me angry?
You: Oh, come on, it’s just a juice! What could possibly happen if I don’t drink it?
Bot: Vitamin A deficiency could lead to weakened immune system, night blindness, skin issues and many more!
What the… These things sound kinda dangerous.
#bot.Expression.clear
#bot.Expression.happy
You: Alright, I will drink your stupid juice!
